skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop a comprehensive understanding of digital marketing strategies including online advertising, social media marketing, email marketing, and content marketing.
Utilize data analysis tools and techniques to evaluate the effectiveness of digital marketing campaigns.
Understand and apply SEO and SEM techniques to improve website visibility and ranking on search engines.
Create engaging and effective content for various digital platforms.
Manage social media accounts effectively to engage audiences and build brand awareness.
Use analytics tools to track and measure the performance of digital marketing campaigns.
